units.source_text: 每年由童男童女乘坐的彩车，都走在游行队伍的前头。

en.t: Every year, the decorated float ridden by the young boys and girls goes at the head of the procession.

units.source_text: 至于其他彩车的先后顺序，则于七月二日或三日由市长举行仪式抽签决定。

en.t: As for the order of the other floats, it is decided by lottery in a ceremony conducted by the mayor on July 2 or 3.
